MERGE INTO erp_person_year AS target USING (SELECT #{centerCode} AS center_code, #{yy} AS yy, #{mm} AS mm, #{classKey} AS class_key) AS src ON ( target.center_code = src.center_code AND target.yy = src.yy AND target.mm = src.mm AND target.class_key = src.class_key ) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET unit_key = #{unitKey}, sub_unit_key = #{subUnitKey}
WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (center_code, yy, mm, class_key, unit_key, sub_unit_key) VALUES (#{centerCode}, #{yy}, #{mm}, #{classKey}, #{unitKey}, #{subUnitKey});
mapper.select: WITH CLASS_KEY AS (SELECT DISTINCT CASE WHEN LEFT(t.class_key, 1) = 'N' THEN SUBSTRING(t.class_key, 2, LEN(t.class_key)) ELSE t.class_key END AS class_key, t.unit_key FROM erp_time_table t WHERE t.center_code = #{centerCode} AND t.yy = #{yy} AND t.mm = #{mm} AND t.class_key IN ('Y', 'S', 'P', 'K', 'M', 'J', 'SU', 'DU', 'ES', 'EP', 'EG', 'ED', 'NES', 'NEP', 'NEG', 'NED')) SELECT ck.class_key AS classKey, cc.class_name AS className, cc.class_type AS classType, ck.unit_key AS unitKey, uc.unit_name AS unitName, CASE WHEN uc.unit_type = 'lv' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS levelUnit FROM CLASS_KEY ck JOIN erp_class_code cc ON ck.class_key = cc.class_key JOIN erp_unit_code uc ON ck.unit_key = uc.unit_key WHERE uc.unit_type <> 'lv' ORDER BY cc.id, uc.id;
SELECT ext_code AS extCode, class_key AS classKey, ocode AS ocode FROM erp_secondary_class_map WHERE center_code = #{centerCode}
SELECT id, class_key AS classKey, class_name AS className, class_type AS classType FROM erp_class_code ORDER BY id
SELECT id, unit_key AS unitKey, unit_name AS unitName, unit_type AS unitType FROM erp_unit_code WHERE unit_type <> 'lv' ORDER BY id

SELECT class_key AS classKey, yy, mm, week, subject_key AS subjectKey, book_name AS bookName, publisher, book_image_url AS bookImageUrl FROM erp_book_suggest WHERE class_key = #{classKey} AND yy = #{yy} AND mm = #{mm}
mapper.update: MERGE INTO erp_book_suggest AS target USING (SELECT #{classKey} AS class_key, #{yy} AS yy, #{mm} AS mm, #{week} AS week) AS src ON target.class_key = src.class_key AND target.yy = src.yy AND target.mm = src.mm AND target.week = src.week WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET subject_key = #{subjectKey}, book_name = #{bookName}, publisher = #{publisher}, book_image_url = #{bookImageUrl}, updated_at = SYSDATETIME() WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (subject_key, book_name, publisher, book_image_url, class_key, yy, mm, week, created_at) VALUES (#{subjectKey}, #{bookName}, #{publisher}, #{bookImageUrl}, #{classKey}, #{yy}, #{mm}, #{week}, SYSDATETIME());

SELECT c.center_code AS centerCode, c.center_name AS centerName, COALESCE(st.cnt, 0) AS studentCount, COALESCE(nw.cnt, 0) AS newCount, COALESCE(lv.cnt, 0) AS leaveCount FROM erp_center c
-- 재원 : 해당 월 시간표에 배정된 학생 LEFT JOIN (SELECT t.center_code, COUNT(DISTINCT ta.student_id) AS cnt FROM erp_time_table t JOIN erp_time_table_assign ta ON t.time_table_key = ta.time_table_key WHERE t.yy = #{year} AND t.mm = #{month} GROUP BY t.center_code) st ON c.center_code = st.center_code
-- 신규 : 해당 월 한자/독서 입회 LEFT JOIN (SELECT es.center_code, COUNT(DISTINCT ta.student_id) AS cnt FROM erp_teacher_assign ta JOIN erp_student es ON ta.student_id = es.student_id WHERE CONVERT(VARCHAR(7), ta.entry_han_date, 120) = #{ym} OR CONVERT(VARCHAR(7), ta.entry_book_date, 120) = #{ym} GROUP BY es.center_code) nw ON c.center_code = nw.center_code
-- 퇴원 : 해당 월 탈퇴 로그 LEFT JOIN (SELECT es.center_code, COUNT(DISTINCT wl.student_id) AS cnt FROM erp_student_withdraw_log wl JOIN erp_student es ON wl.student_id = es.student_id WHERE wl.withdraw_date IS NOT NULL AND CONVERT(VARCHAR(7), wl.withdraw_date, 120) = #{ym} GROUP BY es.center_code) lv ON c.center_code = lv.center_code
WHERE c.center_code NOT IN ('PUS001', 'ALL') AND c.status = 'open' ORDER BY c.center_name

WITH base AS (SELECT t.center_code, p.payment_key, p.student_id, p.yy, p.mm, SUM(pd.amount) AS amount FROM erp_payment p JOIN erp_payment_detail pd ON p.payment_key = pd.payment_key AND pd.item_type = 'BOOK_FEE' JOIN erp_time_table_assign ta ON pd.time_table_key = ta.time_table_key AND ta.student_id = p.student_id JOIN erp_time_table t ON ta.time_table_key = t.time_table_key WHERE p.yy = #{year} AND p.mm = #{month} GROUP BY t.center_code, p.payment_key, p.student_id, p.yy, p.mm HAVING SUM(pd.amount) > 0), approvedBills AS (SELECT payment_key, SUM(amount) AS bill_amount FROM erp_payment_bill WHERE status = 'approved' AND bill_type = 'BOOK_FEE' GROUP BY payment_key), latestBill AS (SELECT payment_key, status, expire_date FROM (SELECT payment_key, status, expire_date, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY payment_key ORDER BY created_at DESC) AS rn FROM erp_payment_bill WHERE bill_type = 'BOOK_FEE') x WHERE rn = 1) SELECT b.center_code AS centerCode, c.center_name AS centerName, s.student_id AS studentId, s.student_name AS studentName, g.grade_name AS gradeName, STUFF((SELECT DISTINCT ', ' + u2.user_name FROM erp_payment_detail pd2 JOIN erp_time_table t2 ON pd2.time_table_key = t2.time_table_key JOIN erp_user u2 ON t2.user_code = u2.user_code WHERE pd2.payment_key = b.payment_key AND pd2.item_type = 'BOOK_FEE' AND t2.center_code = b.center_code FOR XML PATH (''), TYPE).value('.', 'nvarchar(max)'), 1, 2, '') AS teacherName, STUFF((SELECT ', ' + cc2.class_name + COALESCE(' ' + uc2.unit_name, '') FROM erp_payment_detail pd2 JOIN erp_time_table t2 ON pd2.time_table_key = t2.time_table_key JOIN erp_class_code cc2 ON t2.class_key = cc2.class_key LEFT JOIN erp_unit_code uc2 ON t2.unit_key = uc2.unit_key WHERE pd2.payment_key = b.payment_key AND pd2.item_type = 'BOOK_FEE' AND t2.center_code = b.center_code ORDER BY cc2.class_type, cc2.class_name FOR XML PATH (''), TYPE).value('.', 'nvarchar(max)'), 1, 2, '') AS bookName, b.amount AS amount, b.yy + '.' + b.mm AS ym, CASE WHEN lb.payment_key IS NULL THEN 'unbilled' WHEN lb.status = 'issued' AND lb.expire_date >= CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), GETDATE(), 23) THEN 'issued' ELSE 'expired' END AS status FROM base b JOIN erp_student s ON b.student_id = s.student_id JOIN erp_center c ON b.center_code = c.center_code LEFT JOIN erp_grade_code g ON s.grade_key = g.grade_key LEFT JOIN approvedBills ab ON b.payment_key = ab.payment_key LEFT JOIN latestBill lb ON b.payment_key = lb.payment_key WHERE COALESCE(ab.bill_amount, 0) = 0 AND b.center_code NOT IN ('PUS001', 'ALL') ORDER BY c.center_name, s.student_name
